title: Kippenhahn's Conjecture Revisited
summary: In 1951 paper \cite{Ki} Kippenhahn conjectured that if the characteristic polynomial \ $P_A(x_1,x_2,x_3)=\mbox{det}(x_1A_1+x_2A_2-x_3I)$, \ where $A_1$ and $A_2$ are $n\times n$ Hermitian matrices, has a repeated factor in the polynomial ring $\C[x_1,x_2,x_3]$, then the pair $(A_1,A_2)$ is unitary equivalent to a direct sum $(C_1\oplus C_2, \ D_1\oplus D_2)$ where $C_i, D_i\in M_{n_i}(\C) $ for some $1\leq n_i<n, \ n_1+n_2=n, i=1,2$. Kippenhahn verified the conjecture whenever the degree of the minimal polynomial of $x_1A_1 + x_2A_2$ is 1 or 2. In subsequent works \cite{Sh1,Sh2} Shapiro…
